Choose [[Inventory crafting]] or a workstation below to browse what it can make.

Recipes list ingredients, outputs, base AP costs and requirements. Crafting uses ingredients from your inventory first, then from containers within 24 world pixels: adjacent tiles, including diagonals. Corpses are excluded; take their ingredients manually first. [[Inventory crafting]] explains the shared ingredient and AP rules.

In crafting menus, item tooltips reserve extra vertical room for the ingredient list before being moved above the bottom edge. This changes their layout, not recipes or AP costs.

== Crafting experience ==
In 1.0, a successful crafting-menu action starts with half its actual modified AP cost, rounded '''up''' to a whole number. Subtract one for each completed five character levels and grant XP only if the result is positive. The cost itself is rounded to 0.2 AP steps before this calculation; it is not necessarily the recipe's base AP cost.

[[Twine]] is an exception: it starts at 1 XP before the same level reduction. At levels below 5, an actual 2.4-AP craft grants 2 XP; an 8-AP craft grants 4 XP. This is not a fixed percentage increase to every recipe or an AP-cost change.

Find [[Items#Recipe_ingredients_by_acquisition|ingredients by acquisition]] or browse [[:Category:Crafting materials|materials]].
